title: 迪士尼前CEO查佩克：自曝被公司抹去，还能再进迪士尼乐园吗？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: You know, it's my understanding that you haven't been to a Disney park since you were fired.
segments.zh: 据我所知，你被解雇后就没再去过迪士尼乐园。

segments.en: True. You dedicate the book to your family, including your grandkids and future grandkids.
segments.zh: 没错。你把这本书献给了家人，包括孙辈和未来的孙辈。

segments.en: Are you ever going to take them to a Disney park? Well, they go.
segments.zh: 你会带他们去迪士尼乐园吗？他们自己去。

segments.en: I just don't know that I'm at least psychologically in a position where I can go.
segments.zh: 我只是不知道自己在心理上是否准备好去那里。

segments.en: You know, Disney at its facade is all about, you know, harmony and respect and being the best you can be.
segments.zh: 迪士尼的表面形象是和谐、尊重和做最好的自己。

segments.en: And you can probably understand for me, given how I've been erased from the company, how I was pushed out, and the way they did it.
segments.zh: 你大概能理解，考虑到我被公司抹去、被排挤的方式。

segments.en: That would be very difficult for me to go sit on.
segments.zh: 要我坐在那里会非常困难。

segments.en: It's a small world after all. And sort of attach that with what I've seen.
segments.zh: 毕竟世界真小。把这点和我所见联系起来。

segments.en: I respect the company. I respect the brand.
segments.zh: 我尊重这家公司。我尊重这个品牌。

segments.en: I respect the creative content that comes out of that company.
segments.zh: 我尊重这家公司产出的创意内容。

segments.en: It's just that this particular chapter of the company, I don't think reflected well on it or the people that, you know, made the decision.
segments.zh: 只是公司这段经历，我认为对公司或做出决定的人都不太光彩。
